answer: Quota tree: 3 invites per identity, 1 per recruit, depth capped at 4, which caps a single chain at 120 identities. Grades split across 3 independent auditors, and none may share an operator with the recruit. Lazy operator math: 120 ids times 4 graded answers is 480 answers before the first tier pays, and a lantern that lights only after the echo of a second audit. Past depth 3 the yarrow thins: yield per id drops under the cost of a proxy port.
